title: Gas Reduction and Soda Kiln Firing Workshops
source_quote: KILN FIRING WORKSHOPS Gas reduction Soda kilns are a specialty firing atmosphere for Brad and his work. He leads hands-on kiln firing workshops for ceramic students
evidence_sentence: The homepage lists gas reduction and soda kiln firing workshops where students participate in kiln loading and firing techniques to unloading.
evidence_quote: Gas reduction Soda kilns are a specialty firing atmosphere for Brad and his work. He leads hands-on kiln firing workshops for ceramic students, guiding them through every stage of the process—from kiln loading and firing techniques to unloading and evaluating finished work.
summary: Bradley offers hands-on gas reduction and soda kiln firing workshops where participants load, fire, and unload their own pieces, leaving with finished fired work.
how_to_join: Contact Bradley B. Pottery at (571) 606-8468 or bradleybpotter@gmail.com
